mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kit_user (email, password, nickname, role) VALUES (#{email}, #{password}, #{nickname}, 'ROLE_USER')
mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, email, password, nickname, role, created_at AS createdAt FROM kit_user WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT user_id AS userId, email, nickname, role, created_at AS createdAt FROM kit_user ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE kit_user SET role = #{role} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
